note: *As exaltações de Deus na garganta deles*: the blind reader found *exaltações* strange and the stylist named it the worst line. MS1932's *Os louvores* merges exaltátio with laus (149:1, 3); DM1962 has the singular.
*hão de alegrar-se nos seus leitos* (the stylist's) opens the versicle's response alone. The draft's mesóclise *alegrar-se-ão* sounded antiquated; *se alegrarão* heads a sentence with proclisis.
*entre as nações … entre os povos* (MS1932, CNBB). The gate Latinist (minor) asks *sobre*, parallel to 149:9 *sobre eles*; held because the blind reader heard vengeance upon the nations.
*em coro*, the cognate and MS1932's. The CNBB LH, from the Hebrew, has *com danças*; the Greek and L&S's first sense are the ring-dance.
